_note: Style Menu: every look, what it maps to in this editor, and the recipe scripts/storyboard.py uses to preview it. status: built = rendered and checked on real footage; partial = the closest thing there is, differences listed; cut-choice = an edit decision, no setting; not-built = nothing yet; planned = an idea on the list, no recipe (pages and scripts skip it and say so). Card recipes carry stand-in content; pass real content with storyboard.py --content.

H1.name: Logo-swap title
H1.needs: two logo images (she has not supplied them)

H2.name: Cold open + big number
H2.does: title card with one huge white number (card: title, text "80,000", color #fff, size 240, y 90; size caps by text length: about 900 / (characters x 0.6)) over the opening line
H2.missing: starting mid-motion on b-roll and the small sparkle

H3.name: Handwritten overline + bold caps headline
H3.does: title card with "overline" (Caveat handwriting) above a heavy caps headline, left aligned, held for the first sentence (y 100 keeps both above her eyes)

H5.name: Reaction cold open
H5.does: no graphic: pick a 1-2 s reaction span and put it first in edl.json "keep", then the story; an emoji sticker can land on the first caption

C1.name: Small serif, one script word
C1.does: brand.json captions size 56, y 150 (above her head), case lower; fonts.body = Lora, fonts.accent = Caveat in sage; one accent word per caption

C2.name: Bold sans + italic serif accent
C2.does: the current default: Inter bold in the lower third (captions size 92, y 1250), one accent word per caption in Lora italic, sage #B9C8A5 (set "accent": true on the word in edit.json captions)
C2.missing: the thin script CTA line underneath (use a cta card)

C3.name: One word at a time
C3.does: brand.json captions mode word (one caption per word, auto_edit.py does this; the storyboard re-chunks the reel's own captions), caption colour sage, size 120 at y 1250

C4.name: Black on white for screen recordings

C5.name: Tiny thin caption under a big label
C5.does: tiny caption (captions size 44, y 1440, light weight not available) while a title card carries the big label
C5.missing: bottom-left alignment and a thin weight (captions are centred, Inter 600)

L2.name: Tilted polaroid stack
L2.does: card type "polaroids": 1-4 tilted white photo cards fan in, handwritten label on a torn sage strip; small stack in a top corner so it stays off her eyes

L3.name: Beige dotted paper card, one word
L3.does: nothing in this editor; the paper-grid skill (edit-video pipeline) is the nearest paper look

L4.name: Icon tile grid on a torn label
L4.does: card type "tiles": torn cream label above a grid of soft icon tiles (built-in line icons, your own images or a glyph); lower third, captions step aside

L5.name: Caps label + parenthetical + big number
L5.does: nothing as one card; nearest is the count-up motion card (references/motions.md)

L6.name: Red X list
L6.does: card type "xlist": paper card, hand-drawn marks drawn on one by one, handwritten phrases; "mark": "check" (sage, default) or "x" (red)

L7.name: Step label top-center
L7.does: title card with "overline": "step #2:" in Lora italic (overline_font accent), centred, and a one-line title under it, both above her eyes (y 95)

L8.name: Stat card pop
L8.does: card type "stat": white dashboard card with the real number (label, value, optional delta pill and sparkline) pops over the lower half; captions step aside

L9.name: Photo sticker beside your face
L9.does: card type "popup" with "caption" (extends the CALMA corner stickers): framed photo pops in top-left, handwritten caption on a torn strip across its lower edge, shrinks out

H6.name: Time-stamped number opener
H6.does: The opening line is a count plus a result, such as "[number] days ago, [what you did]", on the first second, with the number in the accent color.
H6.when: Story or results reels where you have a real number and a real date (days since, dollars, hours). Real numbers only.
H6.build_note: `title` card with `overline` ("X days ago") and the number as headline, left-aligned; same family as H2/H3.

H7.name: Ranked serif headline + context line
H7.does: A big serif headline built on a number or rating, such as "[number] [things] I use", with a tiny line in brackets under it that says who it is for.
H7.when: Tool, tip or habit round-ups. Use the bracket line for who it is for: (as a solo business owner).
H7.build_note: `title` card with a serif headline in the light color, `overline` or a second line for the bracket line.

H8.name: Built-it lockup: I BUILT MY OWN ___ IN [logo]
H8.does: A tiny spaced caps line, a big italic serif headline, then "IN" and an app logo. Reads like a title card; strong for tool demos.
H8.when: Demoing a system you built. Needs the logo image.
H8.build_note: `title` card + `sticker` for the logo (you supply the image). Close to H1 but with 1 logo.
H8.needs: your own picture(s): a logo, a screenshot, a GIF or photos

H9.name: Contrarian count line
H9.does: The spoken hook is the whole graphic: a line that swaps a big number for a small one, such as "You don't need [big number] [things]. You need [small number]." Plain shot, no title card.
H9.when: Opening any tidy-up or simplify message. The first sentence carries it.
H9.build_note: Cut choice: start on that sentence with no wind-up (like H5, but no reaction).

H10.name: Two-label contrast title
H10.does: A serif title, then 2 small labels left and right of a center mark, such as "[before] | [after]".
H10.build_note: `title` card + two `tag` cards; or `tiles` with two tiles.

H11.name: Community prompt
H11.does: A large centered serif line over street or desk footage that asks viewers to say what they are working on.
H11.when: A warm comment-driver at the start or end.
H11.build_note: `title` card, centered, serif, 2 lines; in the first 3 s or as an end card.

H12.name: Quote-in-a-box hook
H12.does: A white rounded box with a sentence in your viewer's own words, in bold color.
H12.when: Opening on the exact sentence a client says. Pairs with a plain face-to-camera answer.
H12.build_note: Needs a `quote` card (white box, bold coloured text, held 3 s); closest now is a `card` with one row.

card.text: I want to post more / but it eats my week

H13.name: POV / relatable line + reaction GIF
H13.does: A white text box with a relatable line and a GIF reaction popped in.
H13.when: Light humour on a serious topic. Use sparingly; one per reel.
H13.build_note: `title`/`tag` for the line + `popup` with a GIF (already supported, GIFs loop).

cards.text: how I expect clients / to react

H13.needs: your own picture(s): a logo, a screenshot, a GIF or photos

H14.name: Day-N series label (quiet version)
H14.does: "Day [number] of [what you are building]" as a series opener. The quiet version is a small serif "day [number]:" over the headline.
H14.build_note: `title` with `overline` "day [number]:" in the accent font (same as L7).

H15.name: Quoted myth on screen
H15.does: A quoted line floats over a calm shot: a myth your audience hears. You then answer it.
H15.when: Myth-busting. Use a myth in your audience's words.
H15.build_note: `title`, small, with quote marks; hold 3 s; captions below.

card.text: “I'll get organised / when things slow down”

H16.name: Time or money handed back
H16.does: A serif line at the top of the frame stating a result in time or money, over a plain face shot.
H16.when: Only with a true number from your own work (hours saved, a client result you may share).

H17.name: List promise with the number in colour
H17.does: A number-led promise, such as "the [number] I'd give anyone", with the number in the accent color, then the list on screen.
H17.when: Any tips or tools list. Tell them how many up front.
H17.build_note: `title` card with the number coloured; list as L6/L16/L4.

H18.name: Hype claim hook
H18.does: A claim that one thing has ended another, in a white box. Common, and it draws comments by overstating.

H19.name: Question label above the head
H19.does: A small label across the top as a question or a "what most people do" line; the answer starts in the first sentence.
H19.when: Comparing the common approach to yours.

C6.name: White label-box single word
C6.does: One word at a time in black on a white rectangle, centred in the lower middle; the box hugs the word.
C6.when: Direct-to-camera talking head, calm pace; reads as clean and businesslike.
C6.build_note: Caption style `box` (background on the word). Closest now: C3 with `colors.caption` black on a card.

C7.name: Quiet mid-lower white phrase
C7.does: Small clean white sans, 2-4 words at a time, sentence case, centred at about 60% height, no highlight. The face stays the star.
C7.when: A good default for calm explainers and personal reels. Easy to read, easy to live with.

C8.name: Bold word with soft shadow
C8.does: One heavy white word, large, soft drop shadow, centre-lower. High energy without a colour.
C8.when: Fast talkers or a list rhythm.
C8.build_note: C3 with `colors.caption` `#FFFFFF` and size 120; shadow already in the build.

C9.name: Highlighter italic punch
C9.does: A heavy italic line in the accent color on the hook line, white after.
C9.build_note: C2 with the accent color, `"accent": true` on the whole first phrase.

C10.name: Dark translucent phrase bar
C10.does: Two lines of white sans on a dark semi-opaque rounded bar across the lower middle.
C10.when: Busy backgrounds or when a face is partly dark; extra legibility.

C11.name: Keyword colour highlight
C11.does: A white phrase with 1 key word in the accent color.
C11.when: Any explainer; the accent word is the one idea of the sentence.
C11.build_note: C2 recipe, `"accent": true` on one word per caption.

C12.name: Tiny centred serif over b-roll
C12.does: Two-line tiny serif, centred, over aesthetic desk or street b-roll; voiceover feel, no face.
C12.when: Voiceover reels, quote reels, "day in the work" b-roll.
C12.build_note: C1 centered: captions `{"size":44,"y":900}` with a serif body font.

C13.name: Pinned topic label + quiet captions
C13.does: A translucent label holds the topic at the top for the whole point, and small white captions stay low.
C13.when: Teaching one topic for 20-40 s; gives a new viewer instant context.
C13.build_note: `title` card held with `end`, small, + C7 captions.

C14.name: Chunky playful stacked type
C14.does: Rounded chunky words of mixed sizes stacked down the frame.

C15.name: One bold white word, no highlight
C15.does: A single bold white word under the speaker's chin, mid-lower, small. No colour, no box.
C15.when: Hold-up demos (laptop, object) where the picture is busy.
C15.build_note: C3 with white caption colour, size ~96, y 1180.

C16.name: Caption doubles as counter
C16.does: The running caption carries the count, such as "1 of 5", so the rhythm of a list is built into the words. A writing choice: the count is typed into the captions.
C16.when: Rated lists and step lists; viewers stay for the next number.
C16.build_note: Write the count into `edit.json` captions text at each item; plain C7 styling.

L10.name: Inset card over a blurred, enlarged self
L10.does: Your clip sits as a smaller rounded card in the middle; the frame behind is the same clip enlarged and blurred. Caption under the card.
L10.when: Hand-held or off-centre footage you want to dress up; story and diary reels.
L10.build_note: `page` card has the clip framed with a background; needs a `bg: "blur"` option (blurred copy of the same clip).

L11.name: Top asset panel + face below
L11.does: The top half is a rounded panel holding the app icon or screen; your face fills the bottom half; a small label names the panel.
L11.when: Explaining a tool in one line each. Keeps your face on screen the whole time.
L11.build_note: `page` card (background image + clip framed) with your screenshot or logo; small label added.
L11.needs: your own picture(s): a logo, a screenshot, a GIF or photos
L11.missing: the picture fills the whole background behind the title area; a separate top panel with your face filling the bottom half is not built

L12.name: Photo-card cloud above the head
L12.does: 6-8 tilted vertical frames of finished work fan above the speaker; one word of caption below.
L12.when: Proof of finished work. More dramatic than L2.
L12.build_note: `polaroids` allows 4 cards; raise to 8 with a cloud placement.
L12.needs: your own picture(s): a logo, a screenshot, a GIF or photos

L13.name: Logo chips either side of the face
L13.does: 2 app-logo chips sit left and right of the speaker with a one-word label under each.
L13.when: "Which tool for which job" lists, one pair at a time.
L13.needs: your own picture(s): a logo, a screenshot, a GIF or photos

L14.name: Vertical icon list beside the face
L14.does: 4 app icons with names stack down the left side, your face on the right.
L14.when: Showing a stack (tools, platforms, client types) in one glance.
L14.build_note: `tiles` laid out in one column at the left.

L15.name: Whiteboard columns above the head
L15.does: 3 hand-lettered columns on a whiteboard-style chart above the speaker, each in its own ink color.
L15.when: Sorting a messy thing into keep, drop and fix.
L15.build_note: New card `columns` (like `xlist`, 2-3 columns of items drawn in turn). Hand font already bundled.

L16.name: Numbered steps card
L16.does: A white card with numbered rows that appear one by one, left of centre, speaker on the right.
L16.build_note: `card` with `rows` (1. 2. 3.) in the lower third; quiet, not a pop-up.

L17.name: Number chips 1-5 under a caps title
L17.does: A bold caps title with 5 numbered chips in a row.
L17.when: Five-item frameworks; the chips light up as each is spoken.
L17.build_note: New `chips` card or `tiles` with number glyphs.

L18.name: Two-person split
L18.does: Two people side by side with a logo and price between them; labels top-left and top-right.
L18.when: Only with two people on camera.
L18.build_note: Skip unless you film with a second person.

L19.name: Reaction GIF at chest height
L19.does: A small meme/GIF reaction sits across the chest area for a beat to land a joke, then leaves.
L19.needs: your own picture(s): a logo, a screenshot, a GIF or photos

L20.name: Carousel slide as opening or closing frame
L20.does: A designed slide (dark card, big headline) shown full-screen at the start or end of the reel.
L20.when: You already built a carousel; reuse its cover or last slide as the reel opener or CTA.
L20.build_note: `page` or full-frame `image` card with your carousel slide PNG for 1.5-3 s.
L20.needs: your own picture(s): a logo, a screenshot, a GIF or photos

L21.name: Comment-keyword end line
L21.does: The last 3-4 seconds: "Comment [WORD] and I'll send you [the thing]".
L21.when: Whenever you have a freebie to send.
L21.build_note: `cta` card (the CAPS word pops) or `title` card at the end.

card.text: comment GUIDE and I'll send it

L22.name: Small top-left statement block
L22.does: A small 2-3 line statement stays in the top-left corner for the whole reel as a running subtitle of the idea.
L22.when: A single thesis you want held on screen.

card.text: one idea / that stays up / the whole reel

L23.name: Two-line caps title, second line in accent
L23.does: A heavy caps title in 2 lines; the second line sits in the accent color.
L23.when: A strong opening thesis; also a section title mid-reel.
L23.build_note: `title` with a second-line colour option (today one colour per card).

L24.name: Taped note
L24.does: card type "note" (added by By Mel Ross, 0.11.0): a short handwritten note on a scrap of paper, taped up above the head. With a material kit on it uses the kit's real paper and tape (references/material-kits.md); without one, a plain sheet
L24.id_note: Called L10 in the repo until the 58-look Style Menu took L10 for 'Inset card over a blurred, enlarged self'; moved to L24.

H20.name: Arched title with a sparkle wave
H20.does: Your series name curves over your head and wipes in, with a short line under it. Gold sparkles follow your hand as you wave it across the screen.
H20.when: The open of a series reel, like "Demystifying AI, part one". Wave your hand across the frame while you say the name.
H20.build_note: `arctitle` card with `trail`; see references/hand-trail.md. The sparkles need a Mac (Apple Vision tracks the hand); without one the arched title builds alone.
H20.needs: Needs a Mac for the sparkles

v1_added: H6-H19, C6-C16 and L10-L23 were added as ideas and built in 0.19.0 (H18, C14 and L18 stay 'planned': not recommended). They describe common patterns in short-form reels in general terms; no footage, text, code or images from any reel were copied. H20 (arched title with a sparkle wave) was added in 0.26.0.
